title: 動物園の動物（図鑑風）
subject_en: Realistic natural-history field-guide style rendering of zoo animals, each ONE animal full body centred, natural colours, soft shading, accurate anatomy. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: パンダ・コアラ・カピバラなど動物園の人気者を、図鑑風のリアルなタッチで描いた12点です。教材や資料、展示パネルに使えます。
items: a giant panda sitting and holding bamboo
a koala clinging to a eucalyptus branch
a red panda sitting on a branch
a male lion standing with a full mane
a giraffe standing tall, full body
a flamingo standing on one leg
a polar bear walking, fur tinted warm cream
a meerkat standing upright on its hind legs
